dialogue_turns.text: [reading off her phone] Question. 'How early should I get there?'
[to the camera, at once, flat] Two hours.
[turning to him, baffled] What do you do for two hours?
[flat, to her, after a beat] Wait for you.

payload.scene: A phone vlog from the seats of a full indoor basketball arena before the game. A big, warm crowd murmur all round.
payload.sample_context: A ten-second comedy moment played by two close friends on a sports trip. It must sound like two real people talking, quick and natural, never like an advert or a narrator. LUNA, about 25, is cheerful, quick and sure of herself; to her everything is good news. TIMO, about 30, is slow, dry and proud; he never raises his voice. They answer each other fast.

text: Question. How early should I get there? Two hours. What do you do for two hours? Wait for you.
